name: Pacific Shuanglin Bio-pharmacy Co., Ltd.
summary: Pacific Shuanglin Bio-pharmacy Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of blood products in China and internationally. The company offers human serum albumin, human immunoglobulin (PH4), human immunoglobulin, hepatitis B human immunoglobulin, tetanus immunoglobulin, rabies immunoglobulin, human coagulation factor VIII, human fibrinogen, lyophilized intravenous immunoglobulin (pH4), hepatitis B immunoglobulin (pH4), and human prothrombin complex concentrate, as well as intravenous cytomegalovirus immunoglobulin and intravenous respiratory syncytial virus immunoglobulin.
